adverse_significance_findings: General compound minimax order, finite-family feedback training and strict finite compound gaps have primary antecedents; Section 7 is not a new general resource principle.

The uniform classical limit assumes fixed bounded gain and positive normalized-noise floor in a simultaneous signal/noise scaling.
Typical independent Gaussian-book restrictions do not establish arbitrary Gaussian-protocol optimality or decoder achievability.
